d: Deep crimson, straight hair with long lengths and choppy bangs falls over a mature facial appearance with a slender build. The eyes are heterochromatic, featuring a glowing light-blue iris on the right and a golden-yellow iris on the left. This figure wears a metallic silver and black armored outfit accented with deep red fur and a high mechanical collar. Signature details include a red and black headband, and a glowing pink crystalline mark on the upper chest.
